verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere ships an official terminal CLI that can run local models offline and without an account, so it has a documented non-GUI execution path. Nothing in the evidence documents server or CI use, a headless daemon or serving mode, or non-interactive operation. The OpenAI-compatible endpoint is the hosted Wally Cloud service, and cloud auth depends on a browser sign-in. Missing for 10: explicit headless/server mode documentation, CI pipeline usage guidance, non-interactive (no-browser) auth for automated environments, supported server OS/hardware details, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the runtime headlessly with no GUI for use in servers or CI pipelines

citations.quote: When a small model on your own machine is enough, the same CLI runs it, offline and without an account.
